tools.name: make_xlsx
tools.description: Rows (or several named sheets) to an Excel .xlsx file with a download URL. (cost: 3 credits)

tools.name: read_spreadsheet
tools.description: Fetch an .xlsx, .xls, .ods or .csv from a URL and return the rows of a sheet as JSON. (cost: 2 credits)

tools.name: pdf_to_text
tools.description: Fetch a PDF from a URL and extract its text, per page, optionally only some pages (e.g. "1-3,7"). (cost: 3 credits)
